summary: Conviction based on circumstantial evidence; extra-judicial confession scrutinized under panchsheel test; confession deemed unreliable due to contradictions among PWs 10-12; blood-stained clothes and weapon recovery dismissed due to non-compliance with Section 27 Evidence Act; trial court acquittal restored as High Court erred in disregarding testimonial inconsistencies; conviction requiring conclusive evidence chain under Sharad Birdhichand Sarda principle.
legal_provisions_cited: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra
Sahadevan and Another v. State of Tamil Nadu
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court conviction reversed; trial court acquittal restored.
